thread.title: Amazon falls behind Microsoft in US stock market

author: Tor Marie
title: Amazon falls behind Microsoft in US stock market
text:
Pin 0 shares
In a long-running race Microsoft Corp (MSFT) reclaimed its place as second-most valuable American company from Amazon (AMZN) on Friday.
Amazon’s shares dropped by 7% this week following a disappointing quarterly report . Their stock market value had hit an all-time high at $902 billion this July, when Amazon announced a turnover of over $4 billion in product during its annual Prime Day sale.
Microsoft’s stock market value stood at $823 billion on Friday, while Amazon came in at $805 billion.
Apple (AAPL) continues to lead the stock market at over $1 trillion USD after crossing that threshold in early August.
